text_001: E bibliografia a registrá tur título ku a topa i den ki forma nan a keda publiká. A konta título, tomo di seri, kuentanan ku ta relatá na otro i vershonnan di republikashon; stencil, kaft duru, etc.
text_002: Pa a yega na e bibliografia aki a hasi un investigashon digital pa konsultá katalogo di diferente organisashon. Pa verifiká ku e publikashonnan ta eksistí a bishita e organisashon, a kontrolá kolekshonnan privá i papia ku hende.
text_004: E sifranan definitivo di obra, tomo, edishon i publikashon ta dependé di kontrol di e registronan.
text_006: A publiká e mes un obra den diferente forma. Den vershon kompleto i seri repartí ku konteo diferente.
text_008: Wilfrido a skibi diferente seri. Algun tabata karga e mes un título i ta repartí den diferente tomo. Otro ta tin diferente título, pero e mes tabata indiká kua ta e siguiente.
text_009: E numbernan ku falta den un registrashon no ta prueba ku e tomo a wordu publiká.
text_012: Artíkulo, buki, reseña, i otro fuentenan den kua e ta menshoná
text_015: Personanan ku a hasi nan kolekshon personal disponibel i ku ta(bata) dispuesto na duna mi informashon.
text_016: The bibliography records every title located and the forms in which it was published. The research counts titles, volumes within series, related narratives, and republication formats, including stenciled copies and hardback editions.
text_017: To compile this bibliography, digital research was conducted using the catalogues of various organizations. To verify that the publications exist, the researcher visited institutions, checked private collections, and spoke with people.
text_019: Final counts of works, volumes, editions and publications depend on verification of the records.
text_021: The same work was published in different forms, as complete editions and as serial publications divided into varying numbers of parts.
text_023: Wilfrido wrote several series. Some carried the same title across different volumes. Others used different titles, with Ortega himself indicating which work followed next.
text_025: A number missing from a record does not prove the corresponding volume was published.
text_028: Articles, books, reviews and other sources that mention Ortega
text_032: People who made their private collections available and who were, or remain, willing to share information with me.
